desc:
GAME HAS JUST BEEN RELEASED AND IS IN BETA!! Please report bugs and give suggestions and feedback for improvement!

Not everything is as it seems... 🫣🐰😱

JUICE THOUSANDS OF CARROTS 🥕
REACH 1 MILLION COINS 💰💰
BUY UPGRADES ⬆️⬆️⬆️
GET PET BUNNIES  🐰🐰
...and survive?? 💻👻💀

From the creators of Terminal [Escape Room], Mister Rabbit poses an entirely new challenge: you'll have to help Mister Rabbit reach 1 Million Dollars by harvesting carrots, juicing them, selling the juice, and purchasing upgrades. But in this world, something feels odd... and the real world holds threats you cant just turn off...

Mister Rabbit expands on the lore of Terminal [Escape Room], taking place in the same Universe. Can you figure out what's going on, and live long enough to tell the... tail??

WARNING: THIS GAME CONTAINS JUMPSCARES!!
